notes: The original Google signature cannot survive bundle merging or any later modification.
Original Google-signed split APKs remain the preservation baseline, but Pixel Camera 11.0.073 rejects POCO F5 at runtime before the camera UI.
A merged standalone APK is experimental until the real-device runtime smoke test passes on POCO F5 / API 37.

The compatibility build patches the exact unsupported-device constructor throw and, based on POCO F5 runtime evidence, forces Tensor-only GXP/TPU/DarwiNN feature queries off while preserving all unrelated feature flags; both patches fail closed if the expected bytecode shape changes.
A stable repository signing key is required for APK-to-APK upgrades between project-signed experimental builds.

POCO F5 runtime validation reached CameraService successfully but then showed libgxp.so/DarwiNN initialization failures followed by a null Gcam object; the non-Tensor guard prevents selecting those Pixel Tensor accelerator paths.
PairIP is not removed or bypassed by this pipeline.

Real-device validation after the klm feature-query guard still showed libgxp.so probing followed by Gcam.g() on a null native object. The current compatibility patch therefore also keeps the GCam InitParams provider from enabling almond TPU and Tomte grain during startup, preserving their default false state.
